g.title: MarieRank2Convo1 begins.
g.text: MarieRank2Convo1 begins.

g.title: j1192606642
g.text: I hope you do not think me rude for asking, but I am so terribly curious. Do you have a faith ? In the Luminaries or otherwise.

g.title: j4169549912
g.text: What if i said I was more interested in you, instead? Would that be blasphemous?

g.title: j3098453528
g.text: No, it wouldn't be rude at all.

g.title: j242691715
g.text: [End.]

g.title: j2160635051
g.text: Boolean DrifterMarie is now true.

g.title: j3899125862
g.text: It's... complicated. I believe there's something out there, but I don't really have a named faith.

g.title: j2642970864
g.text: Yes, I do. I have a faith I believe in, though it's not one you'd know.

g.title: j1501486258
g.text: I believe in the Luminaries, like you.

g.title: j2351307052
g.text: No, I don't. I don't believe in gods. Just science we don't understand yet.

g.title: j1184006289
g.text: I don't know, honestly. I think the world is too complicated for me to have the answer.

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j3790062076
g.text: Ah, oui ? What is this ? Quelle audace, I must say I am surprised at you ! I was not expecting...

g.title: j1563077325
g.text: Boolean DrifterFaithPersonal is now true.

g.title: j3946249222
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3187431718
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1196803457
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1449905473
g.text: Boolean DrifterFaithAgnostic is now true.

g.title: j2621416485
g.text: But you are trying to distract me ! While I am not opposed, it is far too soon for such things, n'est pas ?

g.title: j1938344099
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1695211337
g.text: Faith by any name I find beauty in. Tell me, is it new ? Old ? Would I recognize it at all ?

g.title: j987444941
g.text: You do ! Oh, comme c'est fascinant ! To think someone holds the faith so far into the future, cela remplit mon cœur de joie. I am overwhelmed with joy. Though I think your time in the past may have had something to do with it, no ? Ah, no matter.

g.title: j568285193
g.text: I respect your response. But I must ask, how are you so certain ? Is that not a kind of faith in itself ? And what is this... Indifférence of yours, if not a god ?

g.title: j3271951428
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j2637691484
g.text: I... would still like an answer to my question, s'il vous plait, if you do not mind. Though now you have me blushing !

g.title: j4156381828
g.text: Ah, oui. A wanderer, that is in your name. You have seen many cultures, many faiths, many worlds. Cela est très spirituel, non ? Collected parts of them like seashells.

g.title: j3745040387
g.text: I don't think you'd recognize it at all, no.

g.title: j2527448670
g.text: You might recognize parts of it. But other parts would be totally foreign to you.

g.title: j653465560
g.text: I wonder, are you devout to one or the other ? Or do you seek the balance ?

g.title: j3280149670
g.text: I'm not perfectly certain I'm right, no one can be. But I still don't personally believe in gods.

g.title: j2590706620
g.text: I think religion exists to fill a hole in people's lives left by the fear of death and the unknown.

g.title: j1432235435
g.text: I don't know what the Indifference is, but it isn't a god. We just need to get to the bottom of it.

g.title: j21792740
g.text: Aah, perhaps the wisest answer of them all! For who are we mere mortals - if we can still claim to be such - to pretend to draw out the design of the Gods ?

g.title: j1188673658
g.text: I think there is also something older, truer, and deeper that speaks to us all. A connective tissue, kind of.

g.title: j2027358488
g.text: Exactly. I see something beautiful in all of them, I don't know as anyone has it right or wrong.

g.title: j2031164985
g.text: Boolean DrifterFaithYesForeign is now true.

g.title: j2250366886
g.text: Boolean DrifterFaithYesSimilar is now true.

g.title: j2695298834
g.text: I find myself drawn more towards Sol.

g.title: j2739411071
g.text: I find myself drawn more towards Lua.

g.title: j1438095668
g.text: I seek balance. I think that's the natural order of things.

g.title: j179710790
g.text: Boolean DrifterFaithNoMaybe is now true.

g.title: j3319854765
g.text: Boolean DrifterFaithNoFear is now true.

g.title: j2430189121
g.text: Boolean DrifterFaithNoMITW is now true.

g.title: j3532769271
g.text: Oft have I sat in the sanctuary of my Cathédrale and spoken gleefully with strangers who have come to learn and nothing more.

g.title: j102141660
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1875375304
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3875327916
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2762542661
g.text: Boolean DrifterFaithSol is now true.

g.title: j959299585
g.text: Boolean DrifterFaithLua is now true.

g.title: j159836630
g.text: Boolean DrifterFaithBalance is now true.

g.title: j1790489741
g.text: Oui, je vois... You perhaps need your own "proof" to be certain? Nothing has happened in your own life to give you such an emotion, like we feel of faith and fervor ?

g.title: j1568045849
g.text: Oui, c'est vrai - that is true. Faith answers many questions for many souls. Do you not fear what may come after death ?

g.title: j4053099415
g.text: Comme c'est fascinant... and now there are two, who repeat the same words... the devil has whispered the same.

g.title: j552576565
g.text: So curious of our faith but not wanting to say "yes, yes, this is the truth." I can only hope I gave them some part of our joy to take with them.

g.title: j732122156
g.text: Je comprends et c'est magnifique. I have often wondered if the Luminaries did not wear other faces. Other names.

g.title: j2782931923
g.text: Oh, comme c'est fascinant ! How I would love to learn of your faith some day. To hear of your rituals.

g.title: j3651933294
g.text: Oh, comme c'est fascinant ! How I would love to hear how it is so aligned and yet so different some day.

g.title: j3228366499
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j996008471
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2621088984
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j541939059
g.text: No, I just don't believe.

g.title: j2974450641
g.text: That's right. I've never... "felt" faith. Or needed it.

g.title: j1188610232
g.text: Everyone dies. To fear it is silly. It comes for us all. Or at least... it should.

g.title: j611576904
g.text: I've died enough times. I don't fear what comes after. I'm eager for it.

g.title: j1986859435
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3212171323
g.text: I'm a little surprised you're open to people not believing in your faith.

g.title: j1764903401
g.text: That's exactly it. I don't want to say one is "right" or "wrong."

g.title: j2782886016
g.text: They have been known to change their forms to please their followers in other sects. But that is my faith, not yours.

g.title: j1542472472
g.text: I'd like that.

g.title: j3514717752
g.text: I'm surprised you're open to the idea of other religions.

g.title: j1987174452
g.text: A wanderer after my own heart ! You bring such a smile to my face. I hope you do not lie to flatter me.

g.title: j2866744000
g.text: Aah, the wanderer follows the night's path like my dear Lyon. When he is ready, you should speak to him of his dark lady's ways, he will be overjoyed.

g.title: j1518178185
g.text: Balance without indecision. To journey through one's life, knowing when the sun must rise and the moon must answer it, but to never fall prey to doubt ?

g.title: j269960062
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3258928145
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j787360287
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2930103098
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1072781671
g.text: It pains my heart to give him any manner of credence but in this ? Perhaps you should speak to him. Simply be wary. The devil plays a dangerous game.

g.title: j2286451660
g.text: I suppose that might be a surprise, to find someone who wears the cloth to not be strict in their expectations of others. I find preaching to those who are not seeking solace does not win much love.

g.title: j3647955796
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3431862181
g.text: I simply hope your faith brings you peace ?

g.title: j3900146551
g.text: Ô joie ! I do so much love to learn. I have often wondered if the Luminaries did not wear other faces. Other names.

g.title: j3023607126
g.text: I suppose that might be a surprise, to find someone who wears the cloth to not be strict in their expectations of others. I find preaching to those who are not seeking solace does not win much love.

g.title: j639044910
g.text: I simply wonder, does our faith bring you peace ?

g.title: j4172874339
g.text: That is a rare gift... and one I hope you wield. To linger at the crossroads too long is to be consumed by strife, I fear.

g.title: j1128283911
g.text: It must be a simpler life, then. To not live by the rules of gods and churches. I admit I am a little jealous.

g.title: j3432495461
g.text: Then I am jealous of you, wanderer ! To live so many centuries, devoid of the need to know the gods.

g.title: j183858709
g.text: You sound like a disciple of Lua, and I mean that with no offense. Oui, the Crone comes for us all, and weeps her silver tears. But your words make me wonder...

g.title: j2374419806
g.text: Oui, it makes me wonder. I look upon you, the child, the devil, even Monsieur Loid, or le Cardinal... so many centuries stretch behind you all.

g.title: j2163488362
g.text: What kind of dangerous game?

g.title: j3741076934
g.text: He doesn't think the Man in the Wall is real, either?

g.title: j3990050470
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2850969614
g.text: I am smiling at your wisdom and kindness towards the beliefs of others.

g.title: j1741495148
g.text: It doesn't.

g.title: j331710084
g.text: I honestly don't think much about it.

g.title: j2055124644
g.text: It does.

g.title: j1738969560
g.text: They have been known to change their forms to please their followers in other sects. But that is my faith, not yours. I will not preach to those who are not seeking for solace. I find it does not win much love.

g.title: j2626982247
g.text: No, my faith is mine, and yours is your own. I simply hope it brings you peace ?

g.title: j3926957405
g.text: In the end, all must choose a path to walk. But the crossroads is where we must all begin, the balance is the foundation of all structures.

g.title: j3075465002
g.text: But, I wonder... does this not believing, does it bring you peace ?

g.title: j318290488
g.text: Of whom do you speak of, when you say "it should" come for you all ? I look upon you, the child, the devil, even Monsieur Loid, or le Cardinal... so many centuries stretch behind you all.

g.title: j2769679171
g.text: I wonder how many centuries stretch before us now, before Lua will come for us. And I wonder how eagerly I will embrace her when that day should come. But that is my faith, not yours.

g.title: j12868536
g.text: I do not know just yet. He keeps his schemes to himself like a good devil. But he believes in no gods. Save, perhaps, himself.

g.title: j3963060627
g.text: Non, he does not. He is much like you, he believes in no gods. Save, perhaps, himself.

g.title: j1990803704
g.text: Non, anyone who comes with an open mind shall be met with open arms.

g.title: j1947875327
g.text: I simply wonder, does this bring you peace ?

g.title: j3311771219
g.text: Boolean DrifterFaithNoPeace is now true.

g.title: j2040577019
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j3087990084
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j4289413605
g.text: Boolean DrifterCrossroads is now true.

g.title: j2740938892
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j962073366
g.text: My jealousy abounds! It would consume me. I would... be eager to speak to you of this again, if you would allow me ? I do not wish to preach or pry. I do not wish to cause you distress.

g.title: j21671774
g.text: Then I know my Sol smiles upon you, whether or not you pray to him, for you have found the only path that you need.

g.title: j2968536621
g.text: Aah, pardonne-moi ! Little Marie is preaching, how embarrassing ! I did not come here to lecture you like a schoolteacher.

g.title: j1696599530
g.text: I am deeply touched by your honesty, wanderer. I would... be eager to speak to you of this again, if you would allow me? I do not wish to preach or pry. I do not wish to cause you distress.

g.title: j2819863005
g.text: I am merely curious, and wish to aid you if I can. Please, tell me no, and we shall never speak of this again.

g.title: j2378590552
g.text: I wonder, may we speak of this again ? I am so very curious to know more.

g.title: j3542881744
g.text: No, thank you.

g.title: j889998962
g.text: Of course.

g.title: j1076906881
g.text: Boolean DrifterFaithStop is now true.

g.title: j1110613843
g.text: Merci, merci ! There is much trust in what you have just given me. I shall not waste it. Until then.

g.title: j349987009
g.text: I understand completely, and I am not offended. Thank you for listening to me, and I am grateful for what you have shared. We shall speak on other matters, Sol knows we have plenty !
